scripts.build: bun run build:pages && bun run build:dash
scripts.build:pages: bun build src/explore.ts src/live.ts src/embed.ts src/chat-overlay.ts src/user-login.ts src/register.ts src/verify.ts src/reset-password.ts src/legal.ts src/wiki.ts --outdir public --entry-naming "[name].[ext]"
scripts.build:dash: rm -rf public/dash && bun build src/dashboard.ts --outdir public/dash --splitting
